description: This file contains functions for generating markdown-formatted diffs between two text versions, including normalization, truncation, and formatting logic, used for notifications in the focalboard server.

classes.name: markDownCfg
classes.description: Configuration struct for markdown diff formatting, specifying open and close tags for insertions and deletions.

methods.name: generateMarkdownDiff
methods.description: Generates a markdown-formatted diff between two texts, skipping superficial changes.

methods.name: generateMarkdown
methods.description: Creates markdown string from diffs with specified formatting configuration.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates text to a maximum length, with different strategies for start, middle, or end truncation.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Normalizes text by replacing tabs, multiple spaces, and newlines with a standardized format.

methods.name: leftWords
methods.description: Returns approximately maxLen characters from the start of a string, including whole words.

methods.name: rightWords
methods.description: Returns approximately maxLen characters from the end of a string, including whole words.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses a slice of strings in place.

methods.name: words
methods.description: Returns a slice of words containing approximately maxChars characters, truncating the last word if needed.
